```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (19.0, 12.0, 22.0),     # diff pair gm/Id
    "L1":    (1.5, 0.5, 2.0),        # diff pair L (flicker noise area)
    "itail": (8e-6, 5e-6, 14e-6),    # tail current
    "gmid4": (11.0, 7.0, 14.0),      # PMOS mirror load gm/Id
    "L4":    (2.5, 1.0, 3.0),        # PMOS mirror L (sets A1 -> PSRR)
    "gmid7": (13.0, 9.0, 15.5),      # 2nd stage PMOS gm/Id
    "L7":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # 2nd stage L
    "i7":    (26e-6, 16e-6, 32e-6),  # 2nd stage current
    "cc":    (1.0e-12, 0.6e-12, 2.0e-12),
    "rz_k":  (1.0, 0.5, 2.5),        # Rz = rz_k*(1+CL/Cc)/gm7
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    CL = spec.get("cl", 2e-12); iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vdd = spec.get("vdd", 1.8); vcm = spec.get("vcm", 0.9)
    it, i1, i7, cc = p["itail"], p["itail"] / 2, p["i7"], p["cc"]

    # ---- bias: Iref diode Mb0, tail & M8 mirror it ----
    gb, Lb = 10.0, 1.0
    mb0 = lut.size("n", gb, Lb, iref, vds=0.6)
    vx = mb0.vgs
    mt = lut.size("n", gb, Lb, it, vds=0.35)
    m8 = lut.size("n", gb, Lb, i7, vds=vcm)

    # ---- second stage PMOS ----
    m7 = lut.size("p", p["gmid7"], p["L7"], i7, vds=vdd - vcm)
    vout1 = vdd - m7.vgs
    # ---- PMOS mirror load ----
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid4"], p["L4"], i1, vds=m7.vgs)
    m4 = lut.size("p", p["gmid4"], p["L4"], i1, vds=vdd - vout1)

    # ---- diff pair (with body effect) ----
    vs = 0.4
    for _ in range(3):
        m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], i1, vds=0.15, vsb=vs)
        vs = vcm - m1.vgs
    # ---- NMOS cascodes on the diff pair ----
    gc, Lc = 15.0, 0.5
    vd1 = vs + 0.2
    for _ in range(3):
        mc = lut.size("n", gc, Lc, i1, vds=max(vout1 - vd1, 0.1), vsb=vd1)
        lo = vs + m1.vdsat + 0.04
        hi = vout1 - mc.vdsat - 0.04
        vd1 = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
    vcas = vd1 + mc.vgs

    # ---- stacked diode Mk on top of Mb0: ibias node = vcas ----
    Lk = 1.0
    target = vcas - vx
    glo, ghi = 3.0, 24.0
    for _ in range(30):
        g = 0.5 * (glo + ghi)
        mk = lut.size("n", g, Lk, iref, vds=max(target, 0.3), vsb=vx)
        if mk.vgs > target:
            glo = g
        else:
            ghi = g
    mk = lut.size("n", 0.5 * (glo + ghi), Lk, iref, vds=max(target, 0.3), vsb=vx)

    # ---- compensation ----
    gm7 = m7.gm
    rz = p["rz_k"] * (1 + CL / cc) / gm7

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MK", "ibias", "ibias", "x", "vss", mk)
    n.dev("MB0", "x", "x", "vss", "vss", mb0)
    n.dev("MT", "tail", "x", "vss", "vss", mt)
    n.dev("M1", "a1", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "a2", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M1C", "n1", "ibias", "a1", "vss", mc)
    n.dev("M2C", "o1", "ibias", "a2", "vss", mc)
    n.dev("M3", "n1", "n1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "o1", "n1", "vdd", "vdd", m4)
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "o1", "vdd", "vdd", m7)
    n.dev("M8", "vout", "x", "vss", "vss", m8)
    n.R("RZ", "o1", "cz", rz)
    n.C("CC", "cz", "vout", cc)

    # ---- predictions ----
    gm1 = m1.gm
    g2eff = m1.gds * mc.gds / (mc.gm + mc.gmbs)
    A1 = gm1 / (m4.gds + g2eff)
    A2 = gm7 / (m7.gds + m8.gds)
    gain_db = db(A1 * A2)
    psrr_db = db(A1 * gm7 / m7.gds)
    cmrr_db = db(2 * gm1 * m3.gm / (mt.gds * (m4.gds + g2eff)))
    ugbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * cc)
    C1 = m7.cgg + m4.cdd + mc.cdd + 5e-15
    wp2 = gm7 * cc / (C1 * CL + cc * (C1 + CL))
    wp3 = 1.0 / (rz * C1) if rz > 0 else 1e12
    dz = rz - 1.0 / gm7
    wz = 1.0 / (cc * dz) if abs(dz) > 1e-9 else 1e15
    wm = m3.gm / (m3.cgg + m4.cgg + m3.cdd + mc.cdd)
    wc = 2 * PI * ugbw
    ph = 90 + math.degrees(math.atan(wc / wp2) + math.atan(wc / wp3) + math.atan(wc / wm)
                          - math.atan(wc / (2 * wm)) - math.atan(wc / wz) * (1 if dz > 0 else -1))
    pm = 180 - ph
    slew = min(it / cc, i7 / (CL + cc))
    settle = 0.5 / slew + 4.6 / wc * (1.3 if pm < 70 else 1.0)
    swing = vdd - m7.vdsat - m8.vdsat - 0.1
    power = vdd * (iref + it + i7)
    kT4 = 4 * 1.38e-23 * 300.15
    s_th = 2 * kT4 * (2 / 3) / gm1 * (1 + m4.gm / gm1)
    KFn, KFp = 2.5e-10, 0.8e-10
    s_fl = 2 * (KFn / (m1.W * m1.L * 1e3) + (m4.gm / gm1) ** 2 * KFp / (m4.W * m4.L * 1e3))
    noise = math.sqrt(s_th + s_fl)

    return n, {"gain_db": gain_db, "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm, "power": power,
               "psrr_db": psrr_db, "cmrr_db": cmrr_db, "slew": slew,
               "settle": settle, "swing": swing, "noise_1k": noise}
```
